declarations.name: Terlan Pinot Grigio
declarations.evidence: Cantina Terlano / Kellerei Terlan (Terlano, Alto Adige, a 143-grower co-op) runs one first-party site on two hostnames, www.cantina-terlano.com and www.kellerei-terlan.com, serving the same content in de/it/en. There is no webshop: /kontakt/onlinepartner/ links out to third-party retailers. IT IS THE SECOND ITALIAN PRODUCER WITH A REAL PER-VINTAGE ARCHIVE, after Ricasoli, and it still declares nothing. The Tradition range page links one page per wine (/weine/pinot-grigio-20/, the trailing number an internal id, not a vintage), and each wine page carries a 'Weitere Jahrgänge' list of 2025 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019, each vintage a ?wine-id={n} query on the same slug. The default page is the current release. For the Pinot Grigio that is the 2025 (Jahrgang: 2025, Alkoholgehalt: 13,5 % vol) and NOT our 2024. The page carries Wein (origin, DOC, grape, vintage, yield, slope, altitude), Ausbau, Technische Daten (alcohol, residual sugar, total acidity), serving and food notes, a vintage report, and a 'Recyclinginformationen' block giving the capsule, cork and bottle materials with their Italian recycling codes — that is the ETICHETTATURA AMBIENTALE obligation, not 2021/2117, and it is the clearest case yet of a producer meeting one label obligation on the web and not the other. Zero matches for Zutat, Nährwert, Inhaltsstoff, kcal, kJ, Energie, ingredien, solfiti or Sulfit in raw HTML and in stripped text. The only 'etichetta' hit is the filename of the label photograph.
declarations.note: THE 2024 PAGE ITSELF WAS NOT FETCHED AND THIS IS A ROBOTS LIMIT, NOT AN OVERSIGHT. cantina-terlano.com/robots.txt is 'User-agent: *' with Disallow: /assets/, /logs/, /media/, /redaxo/, /usage/ and — the one that binds here — 'Disallow: /*?*', which disallows every query string. The vintage archive is reached only as /weine/pinot-grigio-20/?wine-id=192 (2024). This is an ordinary marketing site with no e-label on it, so the 2026-07-30 disclosure exception does not reach it and the directive was honoured in full. The template is identical across vintages and the readable 2025 page of the same wine carries no declaration, so the conclusion is safe on the evidence available, but the 2024 page was not read. The sitemap named in robots.txt answers HTTP 500 with a Laravel 'Ooops, something went wrong!' page. Two web searches for a Terlan e-label or QR destination returned only generic EU-regulation explainers and retailers.

declarations.name: Terlan Pinot Noir
declarations.evidence: OUR EXACT BOTTLING IS ON THE PRODUCER'S OWN PAGE AND IT DECLARES NOTHING. /weine/pinot-noir-25/ is the Tradition Blauburgunder and its default vintage is the current release, which is our 2025: 'Jahrgang: 2025', 'Sorte: 100% Blauburgunder', 'Alkoholgehalt: 13,5 % vol' against Systembolaget's 13,5 % — an exact match on producer, cuvée, vintage and strength, reached without a query string and so without touching the disallowed archive. The page gives origin, DOC, grape, vintage, yield, slope, altitude, vinification, residual sugar 0,9 g/l, total acidity 5,4 g/l, glass and serving temperature, food pairing, a vintage report and a Recyclinginformationen block (the Italian environmental-labelling decree, not 2021/2117). NO INGREDIENT LIST, NO NUTRITION TABLE, NO ENERGY VALUE, NOT EVEN A SULPHITE LINE — zero matches for Zutat, Nährwert, kcal, kJ, Energie, ingredien, solfiti and Sulfit in raw HTML as well as stripped text. This is the Ricasoli finding in Alto Adige: a producer with genuine per-vintage editorial control over its own wine pages, publishing the analysis and the recycling codes and not the ingredients.
declarations.note: The only per-wine link that leaves the site is an 'Etikett' JPEG of the front label and a 'PDF Download' at /weinbrief/?w-id={wine}&l-id={lang} — a Weinbrief datasheet, and a query string, so disallowed by 'Disallow: /*?*' and not fetched. Nothing on the site describes it as an ingredient or nutrition disclosure, so the disclosure exception does not apply to it either.

declarations.name: Köfererhof Pinot Grigio
declarations.evidence: Köfererhof (Kerschbaumer, Neustift/Varna, Valle Isarco — 6 ha, seven white varieties) has A THREE-PAGE SQUARESPACE BROCHURE SITE AND NO PER-WINE PAGE AT ALL. www.koefererhof.it serves one 116 kB document for /, /willkommen, /benvenuto and /welcome — the German, Italian and English versions of a single page about the estate, its 976 founding, its terraces at 650–700 m and its cellar. The complete set of internal links is /, /deutsch, /italiano, /english, /willkommen, /benvenuto, /welcome and /search: there is no range page, no product page, no shop and no vintage stated anywhere on the site. The words Kerner, Grigio, Ruländer, Sylvaner and Riesling appear zero times. Nothing to vintage-match even if a declaration existed, which is the Italian undated-page failure in its most extreme form — not an undated cuvée page but no cuvée page. A web search for a Köfererhof e-label or QR destination returned only foreign retailers (wine.com, Tannico, Pur Südtirol, Meraner Weinhaus).
declarations.note: robots.txt is Squarespace's stock file: a long list of AI-crawler tokens AND 'User-agent: *' in ONE group, so unlike bpdr.com the group binds everyone and the 2026-08-08 RFC 9309 reading is not needed. Nothing it disallows is relevant (/config, /search, /account, /api/, /static/ and a set of query-string forms). The sitemap it names returns a VALID BUT EMPTY <urlset/>, 211 bytes with zero <loc> elements — a Squarespace site with no indexable collections, which is itself the finding. NEW FALSE POSITIVE: the homepage matches 'e-label' four times in raw HTML and zero in text, every hit a Squarespace CSS class — 'event-date-label' and 'Mobile-overlay-folder-item--toggle-label'. Add it to the responsiveLabel/Beaver Builder list.

declarations.name: Köfererhof  Kerner
declarations.evidence: Same estate and same close as product 7045701: www.koefererhof.it is a three-page Squarespace brochure with no per-wine page, no shop, no vintage and an empty sitemap, so there is no producer surface on which the Kerner 2024 exists, let alone a declaration. The wine itself is real and widely sold (Alto Adige Valle Isarco DOC, 100 % Kerner, 13,5 % vol) but every page a search returns for it is a foreign retailer — wine.com, Empire Wine, Tannico, Pur Südtirol, trentinoaltoadigewine.it — and a retailer's transcription is explicitly not a source for this project.
declarations.note: Systembolaget's alcohol for both wines is 13,5 %, which agrees with the retailers' figure for the Kerner 2024 — noted only because it confirms the identity of the bottle, not because anything was found to attach to it.

declarations.name: Hans Rottensteiner Alto Adige Sauvignon
declarations.evidence: Weingut Hans Rottensteiner Srl, Via Sarentino 1a, Bolzano — third generation, founded 1956. The estate's own site is rottensteiner.wine (WordPress, it/de/en), reached after www.rottensteiner-wein.com turned out not to resolve at all. Six range pages (Kitz, Classic, Cru, Select, Trigon, Passito) link one page per cuvée, and the page for our wine states 'Annata 2025' and '14,5 % vol' against Systembolaget's 2024 and 14,0 % — ONE PRODUCT PAGE PER CUVÉE, EDITED FORWARD, the Rhonéa/Paul Mas/GIV failure mode again. Our 2024 is not on the site as a bottling; it appears only in the Premi block, where six critics' scores are attributed to 'Vintage 2024'. The page's only outbound per-wine links are SHOP ONLINE and PRODUCT SHEET. NOTHING RESEMBLING A DECLARATION IS ON THE PAGE: zero raw-HTML and zero stripped-text matches for ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, allergen, energia, kcal, kJ, Zutat and Nährwert.
declarations.fetch_result: shop product page HTTP 403
declarations.note: THE SHOP IS A 403 AND WAS NOT WORKED AROUND. The marketing page's SHOP ONLINE link is https://www.shop.rottensteiner.wine/en/sauvignon-sudtirol-doc-39, a Magento store on a separate host; a single plain request returned HTTP 403 with a 5,8 kB body. That is a technological measure and absolute under the project's rules — no retry, no header games, recorded and left. Its robots.txt would have allowed the product URL (the Disallow list is Magento's stock directories plus about ninety '/*{brand}$' anchored brand-landing slugs, Crawl-Delay 10, sitemap named), so this is a refusal by the server and not by the directives. Worth knowing for later Italian work: those ninety brand slugs show the store sells far beyond Rottensteiner — antinori, zenato, ferrari, livio_felluga, tenuta_dell_ornellaia, angelo_negro and antonio_facchin among them, the last two also in this project's remaining Italian pool — but the host answers 403, so it is not a source for any of them. rottensteiner.wine itself sets Crawl-delay: 10 and every request to it in this run was spaced by at least nine seconds.

declarations.name: Hans Rottensteiner Alto Adige Pinot Grigio
declarations.evidence: Same estate, same shape as product 7171301. The Pinot Grigio page reads 'Annata 2025' and 'Gradazione 13,4 % vol' against Systembolaget's 2024 and 14,0 %; our vintage survives only in the Premi block (Kerin O'Keefe 93, Jancis Robinson 16/20, James Suckling 90, Falstaff 90, Decanter and Wein Plus, all 'Annata 2024'). No ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value and no sulphite line anywhere in raw HTML or stripped text. AND THE SCHEDA TECNICA WAS FETCHED AND SETTLES THE TEMPLATE FOR THE WHOLE ESTATE: https://rottensteiner.wine/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/2025_Pinot_Grigio_it.pdf is a 192 kB one-pager giving annata 2025, grape 100 %, training system, soil, yield 6 000 l/ha, vessel, production 25 000 bottles, drinking window, serving temperature, total acidity 5,8 g/l, residual sugar 2,0 g/l and 13,4 % vol, then STORIA / PROVENIENZA / VINIFICAZIONE / DESCRIZIONE prose. Zero matches for ingredien, solfit, kcal, kJ, energia, nutrizion and allergen. It is the Italian scheda tecnica in its purest form and it is not a declaration. One PDF settles the estate; the Sauvignon's equivalent (2025_Sauvignon_eng.pdf) was not fetched.
declarations.note: THE WORDPRESS UPLOAD-PATH TRAP, CONFIRMED A SECOND TIME. Both schede sit under /wp-content/uploads/2021/06/ and the Pinot Grigio's answers Last-Modified: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 16:27:35 GMT — a 2026 file at a 2021 path, exactly as Pico Maccario's 2019/06 schede did. The filename, not the path, carries the vintage here ('2025_Pinot_Grigio_it.pdf'), which makes the range page a cheap vintage census: the estate documents only its current release and no 2024 PDF is linked from anywhere on the site.

declarations.name: Pranzegg Tonsur white field blend
declarations.evidence: Pranzegg — Martin Gojer, Kampennerweg 8, Bolzano, biodynamic, IT BIO 013 — runs a fourteen-page Wix site (www.pranzegg.com) with one page per cuvée and no shop; orders are by email against a price list. /tonsur is our exact cuvée and it links three PDFs whose anchor texts are 'Weinbrief 2021', 'scheda tecnica 2021' and 'data sheet 2021' — the German, Italian and English versions of one datasheet, AND THE ONLY VINTAGE THE ESTATE DOCUMENTS IS 2021, three years behind our 2024. THE DATASHEET WAS FETCHED AND IT IS NOT A DECLARATION: 'TONSUR L2021 / White field blend: MüTh 55%, PB, Sy, Ch', then vineyard, soil, viticulture, vine age 34 years, plot 0,4 ha, density, yield, a vintage report, vinification, maturation ('without fining or filtration'), 4000 bottles, Alcohol 11,5 %, Residual Sugar <1 g/l and TOTAL SO2 35 MG/L. An SO₂ analysis figure is the French Revelette near-miss in German — it reads like an additive declaration and is not one: no ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value. One PDF settles the template for the estate and the other eight cuvées were not fetched. Alcohol 11,5 % does match Systembolaget's 11,5 %, but for the 2021 bottling.
declarations.note: A '/download' PAGE THAT IS NOT A DOWNLOAD CENTER. The pages-sitemap lists /download, which is the Carl Loewen signature and the reason this producer was probed carefully; it turns out to be an alias of the wines index page (same title, same pageId prefix, no file links at all). The Loewen recogniser is 'Download Center'/'Presse' PLUS 'eLabels', and the second half is what is missing here. robots.txt is Wix's stock file: 'User-agent: * / Allow: / / Disallow: *?lightbox=', a PetalBot block, and Crawl-delay 10 for dotbot and AhrefsBot only. NEW FALSE POSITIVES on Wix: 'kJ' matches 64 times in the raw HTML of one page and zero in the text — every hit is either base64 PNG data ('…ErkJggg==') or the bundler symbol 'webpackJsonp'. Add it to the checkJQuery / __VIEWSTATE list.

declarations.name: MiauMiau PetNat Rosé Pranzegg
declarations.evidence: The cuvée matches — /miau-miau is 'Miau!Miau!, vino rosato frizzante', a pét-nat of indigenous varieties bottled with must added in October and refermented in bottle, which is our MiauMiau PetNat Rosé. The page again links only 'Weinbrief 2021' / 'scheda tecnica 2021' / 'data sheet 2021', so the estate's documented vintage is 2021 against our 2024, and the Tonsur datasheet already established that the template carries an SO₂ figure and no ingredient list. The page's own text is vineyard, soil, biodynamic viticulture and vinification, plus a 'DIFFERENZIARE I RIFIUTI' table giving bottle GL70 and crown cap C/FE91. NO INGREDIENT LIST, NO NUTRITION TABLE, NO ENERGY VALUE, NO SULPHITE LINE.
declarations.note: SECOND ITALIAN PRODUCER IN THIS BATCH TO PUBLISH THE PACKAGING OBLIGATION AND NOT THE INGREDIENT ONE. Every Pranzegg wine page carries the etichettatura ambientale table (material code and bin per component) exactly as Cantina Terlan's 'Recyclinginformationen' does. Two estates, two regions, same choice: the Italian environmental-labelling decree is met on the web and Regulation 2021/2117 is not. Curiosity worth recognising on a natural-wine site: Pranzegg writes its grapes as 'La..ein' and 'Ver…sch' — Lagrein and Vernatsch with letters removed, because the wines are table wines that may not name a DOC variety. A grape-name string search will miss them.

declarations.name: Pranzegg Rosso per tutti
declarations.evidence: AND THE CUVÉE ITSELF IS UNCERTAIN HERE, WHICH WOULD BLOCK A FIND EVEN IF ONE EXISTED. Pranzegg's site lists nine cuvées — Tonsur, Elysion, Caroline, GT, Miau!Miau!, Demian, Vino Rosso Leggero, Ca'l and Laurenc — and NONE of them is called 'Rosso per tutti'. The only candidate is /vinorossoleggero, 'VINO ROSSO LEGGERO, leichter Rotwein aus heimischen Sorten Ver…sch, La..ein', an easy-drinking Vernatsch/Lagrein red that fits the Swedish bottle's profile but not its name. The estate may label it 'rosso per tutti' on the bottle or for export, and it may not; nothing on the producer's surface says so. Under the matching rules that is an unresolved cuvée and the wine is closed. It is moot in any case: the page links only the 2021 Weinbrief / scheda tecnica / data sheet, three vintages behind ours, and the estate's datasheet template carries an SO₂ figure and no ingredient list.
declarations.note: The whole Pranzegg site is server-rendered and readable despite being Wix — the per-wine text and the PDF hrefs are in the HTML — but the pages are 670–690 kB each for about 1,5 kB of text. Budget for the size.

declarations.name: Riesling Trentino
declarations.evidence: Cantina La-Vis (Lavis, Trentino, a co-op of the Colline Avisiane) runs two first-party surfaces: the marketing site la-vis.com — www.cantinalavis.it 301s to it — and the group's own WooCommerce shop lavinotecalaviscembra.it, shared with its sister co-op Cembra Cantina di Montagna. BOTH WERE READ AND NEITHER DECLARES ANYTHING. The marketing page for our exact cuvée is the Italian undated cuvée page in textbook form: line (I Classici), grape, zone, exposure, altitude, soil, training, planting density, vinification, food pairing, 'Grado alcolico 12% vol.' — which matches Systembolaget's 12,0 exactly — serving temperature, and a Riconoscimenti list whose awards are dated by vintage (2023, 2022, 2021, 2018) while the page itself states none. IT DOES LINK A PER-VINTAGE SCHEDA TECNICA AND IT IS OUR VINTAGE: 'Classici_Riesling_Lavis_vintage24.pdf'. THE PDF WAS FETCHED AND IT IS NOT A DECLARATION — the same fields as the page (vitigno, esposizione, terreno, allevamento, densità, vinificazione, abbinamenti, 12 % vol., serving temperature) and zero matches for ingredien, solfit, kcal, kJ, energia, nutrizion and allergen. The shop's product page adds weight, ageing potential and a 1,25 kg shipping weight and links the PREVIOUS vintage's sheet, 'Classici_Riesling_Lavis_vintage23.pdf'; it states no annata at all and matches none of the declaration markers either.
declarations.note: THE GIV PREDICTOR WAS TESTED HERE AND FAILED. The closing advice of the first Italian batch was to prefer groups that run their own e-commerce, because that is where both Italian declarations were found. La-Vis is exactly that shape — a co-op group with a 50-product WooCommerce store of its own — and the store carries no ingredient list, no nutrition table, no allergen line and no vintage field. Running your own shop is not sufficient. TWO CHEAP THINGS THIS PRODUCER TEACHES: (1) A SCHEDA TECNICA FILE NAME CAN CARRY THE VINTAGE WHERE THE PAGE DOES NOT — '…_vintage24.pdf' — so on an undated Italian cuvée page, read the PDF href before giving up on vintage-matching; and (2) the two surfaces disagree, the marketing site being one vintage ahead of the shop, so a producer's own vintage marker depends on which of its sites you read. NEW FALSE POSITIVE: 'e-label' matches 35 times in the raw HTML of every la-vis.com page and zero in the text — all of them the cookie banner's 'cm-cookie-label' class. Both robots.txt files are permissive (Yoast's 'User-agent: * / Disallow:'); la-vis.com's sitemap_index names a wine-sitemap of 43 per-cuvée URLs in it/en, which is a one-request range census.

declarations.name: Cantina Lavis Sauvignon
declarations.evidence: Same producer, same template, and here the documented vintage is behind ours as well as the page being undated. The I Classici Sauvignon page gives grape Sauvignon Blanc, zone Giovo, exposure, soil, training, density, vinification, pairing and 'Grado alcolico 12,5% vol.' — matching Systembolaget's 12,5 — and no vintage; its awards are attributed to Vintage 2024 and its scheda tecnica is 'Classici_Sauvignon_Lavis_vintage24.pdf', one vintage behind our 2025. The Riesling's sheet was fetched and settles the template for the estate — analysis and prose, no ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value — so this one was not fetched. Nothing on la-vis.com or on the group shop lavinotecalaviscembra.it carries a declaration for any wine.

declarations.evidence: THE FIRST ITALIAN DECLARATION THIS PROJECT HAS ATTACHED TO A WINE, AND IT IS INLINE ON THE PRODUCER'S ORDINARY MARKETING PAGE. Az. Agr. Cà dei Frati, Via Frati 22, Lugana di Sirmione (BS), P.IVA 00631300985 — the Dal Cero family estate, Lombardia, which is Systembolaget's producer and region. https://cadeifrati.it/vini/pratto/ is the page for the cuvée Pratto and it states, in server-rendered HTML in a block of its own immediately above the ingredient heading: 'Annata: 2024', 'Bottiglia: 750 ml', 'Grado alcolico: 13 % vol', 'PRODOTTO IN ITALIA – CONTIENE SOLFITI'. ALL FIVE MATCHING TESTS PASS EXACTLY: producer Cà dei Frati; cuvée Pratto (the estate's only wine of that name — its range is I Frati, Brolettino, Pratto, Rosa dei Frati, Ronchedone, Tre Filer, Cuvée dei Frati and the Privilegio di Famiglia bottlings, none of them confusable); VINTAGE 2024 against Systembolaget's 2024; pack 750 ml against 750 ml; alcohol 13 % vol against 13,0 %, a difference of zero. The declaration itself is a proper 'Ingredienti' list — grapes, concentrated must, stabilisers (citric acid, gum arabic, CMC), preservatives and antioxidants (sulphites, L-ascorbic acid), bottled under protective atmosphere — followed by a 'Dichiarazione nutrizionale per 100 ml' table with energy in kJ and kcal and the full six rows. The page's 'Scarica la scheda tecnica' link is /wp-content/uploads/2026/07/pratto2024_ST.pdf, whose file name independently confirms the vintage the page is describing. THE LIST IS A HOUSE TEMPLATE BUT THE DECLARATIONS ARE PER WINE: Pratto and Rosa dei Frati carry a word-for-word identical ingredient line and DIFFERENT energy values (337 kJ / 81 kcal against 317 kJ / 76 kcal), which proves two disclosures rather than one boilerplate.
declarations.note: THE DECLARATION IS NOT WHERE THE QR CODE POINTS, AND THAT IS THE LESSON. cadeifrati.it's sitemap index contains a custom post type sitemap, qr-code-promo-sitemap.xml, listing 96 URLs in a two-level shape — /qr-code-promo/{wine}-landing/ (a bare language chooser) and /qr-code-promo/{wine}-landing/{wine}/ in it/en/de. It is the most e-label-shaped URL tree seen in Italy so far and it is NOT an e-label: the leaf page is a tasting note, the estate's history and a Wine Experience booking pitch, with zero matches for ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia. The actual declaration sits on the ordinary /vini/{wine}/ marketing page, which no QR tree points at. An Italian producer can run QR landing pages for marketing and meet 2021/2117 somewhere else entirely — check /vini/ before concluding from a /qr-code-promo/ page. robots.txt is Yoast's permissive 'User-agent: * / Disallow:' and no exception was needed anywhere on this host. Same 'e-label' raw-HTML false positives as elsewhere in this batch: 18 hits, all 'slideLabel' and 'whitelabel' in JavaScript, zero in text.

declarations.name: Marchesi di Barolo Moscato d´Asti Zagara
declarations.evidence: Cantine dei Marchesi di Barolo S.p.A., Via Alba 12, Barolo (CN), P.IVA IT00169530045 — the estate itself, and OUR EXACT BOTTLING IS ON ITS OWN SHOP WITH NOTHING DECLARED ON IT. shop.marchesibarolo.com is the house's own e-commerce (robots.txt 'User-Agent: * / Allow: /', sitemap named, 2 503 URLs) and it keeps ONE PRODUCT PER VINTAGE, not one per cuvée: the sitemap holds moscato-d-asti-zagara-docg-2024 AND …-2025 as separate products, which is the vintage control this project usually only gets from Vincod. The 2024 page states 'Annata 2024', 'Denominazione DOCG', 'Vitigni Moscato 100%', 'Alcol 5%', 'Formato 0.75l' — matching Systembolaget's 2024, 5,0 % and 750 ml exactly — and under a heading 'Info' the single line 'CONTIENE SOLFITI - PRODOTTO IN ITALIA'. THAT IS THE ITALIAN NEAR-MISS AND IT IS NOT A DECLARATION: two of the label's mandatory particulars, no substances, no nutrition table, no energy value. Zero matches for ingredien, nutrizion, kcal, energia and allergen in raw HTML and in text. The market and language were selected as /it/eur/it — Italy, euro, Italian — which is the EU consumer view; the shop also offers en and de and fifteen other shipping countries including the United States, and none of those was used.
declarations.note: TWO HOST QUIRKS. 'www.marchesibarolo.com' fails TLS with a hostname mismatch (the certificate does not cover the www form) and 'www.marchesidibarolo.com' fails with an unresolvable issuer — the live site is the apex 'marchesibarolo.com'. That apex serves a SOFT 404 for /robots.txt: HTTP 200 carrying a black '404 – Pagina non trovata' page, so there are no directives on the marketing host at all (the shop subdomain has a real and permissive one). The marketing site is a pre-rendered Nuxt static export — 1 MB of HTML per page for under 2 kB of text, but fully server-readable, so unlike Les Quatre Tours' Nuxt SPA it is not a rendering dead end. ITS PER-CUVÉE PAGES ARE UNDATED (Zagara's states grape, 5 % Vol, Formato 0,75 l and no vintage) AND THE SHOP'S ARE NOT — on an Italian producer with both surfaces, go to the shop for the vintage. The marketing page's 'Scheda tecnica' is /pdf/it/{slug}.pdf; zagara.pdf was fetched and is zona di produzione, vinificazione and organoleptic prose with zero matches for ingredien, solfit, kcal, kJ, energia, nutrizion, allergen and even 'annata' — an undated scheda tecnica, so it settles the template for the estate and no second PDF was fetched.

declarations.name: Marchesi di Barolo Dolcetto d´Alba Madonna del Dono
declarations.evidence: Same shop, same template, same absence. The per-vintage product page reads 'Dolcetto d'Alba MADONNA DEL DONO Doc 2024', 'Annata 2024', 'Vitigni Dolcetto 100%', 'Alcol 13%', 'Formato 0.75l', and under 'Info' the same single line 'CONTIENE SOLFITI - PRODOTTO IN ITALIA'. No ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value. declarations.note: The shop's sitemap is a cheap and unusually complete census: 2 503 URLs, one per product per market per language, the market segment being /{country}/{currency}/{lang}/ and the vintage being part of the product slug. One fetch tells you every vintage of every wine the house sells and in which markets — worth remembering for any producer on the same platform (support is at marchesidibarolo@wineplatform.it, so the vendor appears to be 'wineplatform.it').

declarations.name: Donna di Valiano Chardonnay
declarations.evidence: Tenute Piccini S.p.A., Località Piazzole, Castellina in Chianti (SI), P.IVA 00368360525 — an eleven-brand Tuscan group (Piccini, Valiano, Torre Mora, Tenuta Moraia, Regio Cantina, Villa al Cortile, Geografico, Porta Rossa, Donna Gloria, Bastioni della Rocca) running its own first-party e-commerce at shop.piccini1882.it, which is exactly the shape the last Italian batch recommended starting from. OUR EXACT BOTTLING HAS ITS OWN PRODUCT PAGE AND DECLARES NOTHING. The page reads 'Donna di Valiano Toscana Chardonnay IGT 2024 - Valiano', 'Annata 2024', 'Vitigni Chardonnay, Sauvignon Blanc', 'Alcol 13%', 'Formato 0.75l', and under a heading 'Info' the single line 'CONTIENE SOLFITI - PRODOTTO IN ITALIA'. No ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value; zero matches for ingredien, nutrizion, kcal, energia and allergen in raw HTML and in text. Vintage and pack match Systembolaget exactly; the alcohol is 13 % against Systembolaget's 12,5 %, half a point, which is moot with nothing to attach. The corporate site www.piccini1882.it (WooCommerce, /catalogo/ and /prodotto/{slug}/) carries no declaration either and its product pages link out to this shop.
declarations.note: A PLATFORM IS NOW IDENTIFIED AND IT IS THE SAME ONE MARCHESI DI BAROLO USES. Both shops answer at {shop}.{producer}.it with the path /{country}/{currency}/{lang}/prodotti/{slug-with-vintage}, both name their sitemap from a permissive 'User-Agent: * / Allow: /' robots.txt, and both print the identical field set — Annata, Denominazione, Vitigni, Alcol, Formato, Temperatura di servizio, then 'Info: Contiene Solfiti - Prodotto in Italia'. Marchesi's customer-care address is marchesidibarolo@wineplatform.it, so the vendor is wineplatform.it. IT IS EXCELLENT FOR IDENTITY AND EMPTY OF DECLARATION: one product per vintage, the vintage in the slug and in the page, the pack and the strength stated — and an allergen line where the ingredient list should be. Two producers, four wines, the same near-miss. Recognise it and expect nothing. Its sitemap is a complete census (8 221 URLs here, 263 Italian-market products across all eleven brands) and is the cheapest possible vintage check. TRAP: the <title> is stale where the H1 is current — this page's title says 'IGT 2023' and the Collezione Oro's says '2022', while both H1s say 2024. Read the H1 and the Annata field, never the title.

declarations.name: Piccini Collezione Oro Chianti Organic
declarations.evidence: THE CUVÉE DOES NOT EXIST ON THE PRODUCER'S OWN SURFACE, WHICH WOULD BLOCK A FIND EVEN IF THERE WERE ONE. Systembolaget sells 'Piccini Collezione Oro Chianti Organic' 2024, 750 ml, 13,0 %, flagged organic, Sangiovese, in the fast assortment. Tenute Piccini's own shop lists 263 Italian-market products and its Collezione Oro range is Chianti Governo 2023, Chianti Riserva 2022, Chianti Superiore 2022/2023/2024, Rosso Toscana, Rosato, Orvieto Classico and a Gran Cuvée — AND NOT ONE OF THEM IS ORGANIC. The group does sell organic wines and labels them plainly, with 'bio' in the slug (Histrio Anfora, Scalunera, Calandrino, Primasso, Il Pacchia, Genesi, Casarossa, Valiano Chianti Classico bio), so the absence of a bio Collezione Oro is informative rather than an artefact of naming. The nearest sibling, Collezione Oro Chianti Superiore DOCG 2024, was read to be sure: same producer, same range, same vintage, 13 % vol and 0,75 l matching Systembolaget — and zero occurrences of bio, biologico or organic anywhere in its HTML. That is a different bottling, so it cannot stand in for ours. This is the export-only brand rule at the level of a single SKU: an organic bottling made for a foreign shelf and absent from the producer's own catalogue. Its page would have declared nothing in any case — every product on this shop carries only 'Contiene Solfiti - Prodotto in Italia'.
declarations.note: Recorded not_found rather than rejected because nothing was found to reject — no declaration was read for any candidate bottling. The identity failure is worth flagging separately for a later run: if Piccini ever publishes, this wine will still need the organic Chianti to appear on the producer's surface before anything can be attached to it.

declarations.fetch_result: 200, but the site is a maintenance placeholder; TLS certificate mismatch on the host (see note)
declarations.note: HOST QUIRK: www.paoloscavino.com and paoloscavino.com both resolve to 146.59.214.79 (plskx-r5.sistnet.it, a Sistnet shared host) and serve a certificate whose CN and SANs are sistnet.it, *.sistnet.it and *.sistnet.cloud only — the producer's own hostname is not in it, so every verified HTTPS request fails with a hostname mismatch, and plain HTTP 301s to HTTPS. The maintenance page was read once with certificate verification disabled; that is a broken server configuration, not a refusal (no 401, 403, 429 or challenge), but it does weaken authentication, so NOTHING WOULD HAVE BEEN ATTACHED FROM THIS HOST WITHOUT NOTING IT. Moot here: the page carries no wine content at all. Revisit candidate — all three Scavino wines are 2024/2025 and the site is explicitly being rebuilt.

declarations.name: Marco Porello Roero Arneis

declarations.name: La Pruina Primitivo Sole Range
declarations.raw_ingredients: Uve, conservanti (E220, E224), agenti stabilizzanti (E414, mannoproteine), L’imbottigliamento può avvenire in atmosfera protettiva
declarations.evidence: La Pruina Vini (Salento, Puglia). The estate's WooCommerce product page https://www.lapruinavini.com/product/primitivo-puglia/ is headed 'La Pruina Primitivo Puglia IGP', states 'ANNATA 2024', 'Vitigno: Primitivo', 'Titolo alcolometrico: 12,5%', 'E/100 ML: 326 kJ / 78 kcal', 'PRODOTTO IN ITALIA', 'CONTIENE SOLFITI', is tagged 'Sole Range', and ends with an anchor reading 'VALORI NUTRIZIONALI E INGREDIENTI | SMALTIMENTO — CLICCA QUI' pointing at https://app.ioagri.it:443/Qr/DL?id=74046361. FIVE INDEPENDENT THINGS TIE THAT E-LABEL TO THIS BOTTLE. (1) The e-label's own CompanyName is 'La Pruina Vini' and its ProductName is literally 'La Pruina Primitivo Puglia IGP Sole Range' — Systembolaget's product name is 'La Pruina Primitivo Sole Range'. (2) Its AlcoholPercentage is '12,50' against Systembolaget's 12,5 % — exact. (3) Its energy, 326 kJ / 78 kcal per 100 ml, is the same figure the producer's own product page prints, and it differs from the sibling Sole Range Negroamaro's 322/77 and from the Manduria DOP's 331/79, so this is a per-wine disclosure and not a house template. (4) The producer's 'Sole Range' tag archive contains exactly two products, this one and the Negroamaro, matching the two Sole Range wines Systembolaget lists. (5) The grape is Primitivo on both sides. HOW raw_ingredients WAS PRODUCED: the payload holds the ingredients as structured rows, and the sentence the reader sees is composed in the browser by the vendor's own RenderIngredients() in /Scripts/Plugins/QrLabelPublicVM. That function was fetched and reimplemented exactly, so the string above is the vendor's composition and not ours; it renders E220 and E224 in bold as allergens, which is dropped here. THE UNDERLYING ROWS, VERBATIM FROM THE PAYLOAD, ARE: materiale grezzo / uve; additivi — conservanti / anidride solforosa (E220); additivi — conservanti / metabisolfito di potassio (E224); additivi — agenti stabilizzanti / gomma arabica (E414); additivi — agenti stabilizzanti / mannoproteine; plus ShowCanBottledProtectiveAtmosphere = true ('L’imbottigliamento può avvenire in atmosfera protettiva') and ShowContainsSulphites = true ('Contiene solfiti'). If normalize.py would rather have the names than the E-numbers, they are here. LIMITS: the e-label states no vintage, no bottle size and no lot, so it identifies itself no better than f-label or apys and the vintage rests entirely on the producer's linking page; Systembolaget's 750 ml is unconfirmed by the source.

declarations.name: La Polda Spumante Rosé
declarations.evidence: Az. Agr. VIGNA '800 di Elampini Gianfranco, Via Moron 46, Negrar di Valpolicella, P.IVA 03267950230 — a Squarespace marketing site (vigna800.com) plus a separate Squarespace shop (vigna800shop.com). Our wine has its own page, /lapolda, headed '"LA POLDA" ROSÉ Spumante Vino Spumante Rosato BRUT', 'Vitigni: 100% Corvina BIO', 'Analisi: alcol 12% vol; acidità totale 6,9 g/l; residuo zuccherino 8,2 g/l; pressione 5,5 atm' — cuvée, grape, organic status and strength all match Systembolaget, AND THE PAGE STATES NO VINTAGE. Its 'SCHEDA TECNICA' PDF, /s/schede_Spumante.pdf, was downloaded and read in full: bilingual IT/EN, soil, grape, yield, harvest, vinification, organoleptics, food pairing, then a data block giving Alcol 12% vol, Acidità totale 6,9 g/l, Residuo zuccherino 8,2 g/l, Pressione 5,5 atm — no ingredient list, no nutrition table, no energy value, no sulphite line and no vintage. The Italian scheda tecnica near-miss in its purest form. Neither the marketing page nor the shop page carries any of ingredien, nutrizion, solfit, kcal, energia or dichiarazione in raw HTML or in stripped text.
declarations.note: THE MOST EXPLICIT INTENTION TO PUBLISH SEEN IN ITALY, AND THE LINK IS DEAD. Every page of vigna800.com carries, in its site-wide footer, an anchor reading literally 'Ingredienti/smaltimento' — the two obligations named together — pointing at /s/schedaAMARONE_2023_ITA_EN.pdf. THAT URL RETURNS HTTP 404 (Squarespace's Italian 'Non è stato possibile trovare la pagina che stai cercando'), confirmed by HEAD and by GET, and it is the same dead link on the English pages ('/la-polda-eng' footer). So one PDF, named for the Amarone 2023, was meant to serve as the whole estate's ingredients-and-disposal document and is no longer there. No replacement URL is linked anywhere on either host, and guessing one is exactly what this agent must not do. Recorded as not found, with the broken link named so a later run can see it was looked for. Both hosts are Squarespace and both robots.txt files put 'User-agent: *' in the SAME group as the named AI crawlers, so the group binds us and no RFC 9309 reading arises (the Köfererhof shape, not the bpdr.com shape); only /config, /search, /account, /api, /static and a list of query-string forms are disallowed, none of which was fetched. Confirmed false positives on both hosts: 'e-label' matches Squarespace's 'event-date-label' and Iubenda's 'whitelabel', and 'kJ' matches base64 image data.

No alternative host: Bila-Haut and Marius are both published under chapoutier.com and no separate domain resolves. FIRST CLOUDFLARE CHALLENGE IN THIS PROJECT — French estates are more likely to sit behind one than German ones were.

_runs.batch: 3g — Gérard Bertrand, 3 wines (Clairette du Languedoc Adissan 2024, Côte des Roses rosé 2025, Gris Blanc rosé 2024 magnum)
_runs.result: 3 attempted, 0 found, 3 not found, 0 rejected. THE CLEANEST NEGATIVE IN THE FILE SO FAR. A 581-product Shopify catalogue keyed by cuvee, vintage and format; the exact page for two of the three wines exists at our exact vintage and pack; and a grep of both pages for nine declaration keywords returns nothing at all. 212 site pages, none about ingredients; 73 Shopify metaobjects, all estates, distributors and recipes. The per-product CDN datasheet PDF is the Von Winning near-miss again — vinification and tasting notes, no list. Scale and structure predict publication no better in France than in Germany.

_runs.result: 2 attempted, 0 found, 0 not found, 2 REJECTED ON VINTAGE. THE FIRST FRENCH PRODUCER IN THIS PROJECT THAT PUBLISHES AN INGREDIENT LIST AT ALL — a full mandated set, inline and server-rendered, on its own PrestaShop product page under 'Ingrédients / Nutrition'. Both of our wines are the 2024 and the shop has rolled to the 2025, and PrestaShop keeps one product per cuvée, so there is no 2024 page. France's failure mode has finally shifted from Germany's shape to Germany's other shape.

_runs.batch: 3h — Les Vignerons de Tavel & Lirac, 2 wines (Tavel Trésor des Sables 2025, Tavel Cuvée Royale 2025)
_runs.result: 2 attempted, 0 found, 2 not found, 0 rejected. Chosen as a direct replication of Rhonéa — a second Rhône cooperative with a modern shop — and it did not replicate. The co-op runs a WooCommerce marketing site and a Shopify boutique, both server-rendered, sells BOTH of our cuvées at OUR EXACT 2025 vintage, keeps separate per-vintage products, and returns zero hits for ingrédient, nutrition, allergène, sulfite, kcal or énergie on either product page. _runs.batch: 3c — the French cooperative hypothesis, plus two Alsace houses picked for sibling economics. Cave de Turckheim, La Cave des Vignerons de Pfaffenheim, Cellier des Dauphins, Les Quatre Tours, Gustave Lorentz, Hugel, Vignerons Proprietes Associes — 12 wines, all vintage 2024 or 2025, all not_declared
_runs.result: 12 attempted, 0 found, 9 not found, 3 rejected. THE COOPERATIVE HYPOTHESIS DID NOT HOLD: five co-ops (Turckheim, Pfaffenheim, Cellier des Dauphins, Les Quatre Tours, Vignerons Proprietes Associes) produced one declaration between them, and it was a vintage behind. BUT THE RUN FOUND TWO PLATFORMS. (1) ALLIANCE NUTRI, alliance-alsace.com/01/{gtin}/22/{variant} — the project's first GS1 Digital Link and its first third-party e-label vendor on a French producer's page, server-rendered, 11 EU languages including Svenska, honours Accept-Language, and states designation, sweetness, vintage, format and GTIN. Found via Cave de Turckheim's 'INGREDIENTS ET NUTRITION' button; rejected only because the shop had not rolled forward to our 2025. (2) VINCOD IS VIN.CO, and m.rhonea.fr and m.hugel.com are the same platform — images from cdn.vin.co, every short code mirrored at vincod.com. Its per-wine page carries a <select id=millesime> naming the code for every vintage back to 2007, so OUR vintage is reachable from the producer's own control, and the vintage page can link a true e-label at /{code}/n/{hash}/{lang} with lot number, labelled alcohol, ingredients and nutrition per 100 ml and per 125 ml. That corrects the earlier reading of Rhonea: the platform is capable of an ingredient list and Rhonea had not filled it in. TWO COMPLETE HUGEL DECLARATIONS FOR OUR EXACT 2024 BOTTLES WERE READ AND BOTH WERE REJECTED ON STRENGTH — 12 % vol against Systembolaget's 13,0 and 14 % vol against 13,0, each twice the 0,5 % vol tolerance and in opposite directions, so not a rounding artefact. The third Hugel, whose strength agrees exactly, is the one whose page carries no e-label link. Also first in this project: a GEOBLOCK — boutique.gustavelorentz.com answers 403 'This website is only authorised from France and Germany', treated as a technological measure and absolute.

_runs.batch: 3d — the Alsace 2024+ undeclared pool to exhaustion, plus the largest Alsace-headquartered brand owner and the largest single-producer cluster left in France. Dopff & Irion, Blanck Andre et ses Fils, SARL Etienne Simonis, Faller Henri et Luc, Les Grands Chais de France, Marc Morey — 14 wines.
_runs.result: 6 producers, 14 wines, 0 FOUND, 0 rejected, 14 not found. THE ALSACE ESTATE POOL OF 2024+ UNDECLARED WINES IS NOW EXHAUSTED — 13 wines, 8 producers — and only the two already known, Cave de Turckheim and Hugel, publish anything at all. ALSACE WAS NOT THE VEIN IT LOOKED LIKE: the two platform adoptions found there in batch 3c were the whole of it, and the four estates left behind them published nothing. What the batch established instead. (1) Dopff & Irion runs the same VINIUM framework as Pfaffenheim AND HAS THE SAME OWNER, so those are one observation and not two; unlike Pfaffenheim's, its marketing URLs redirect into the shop, so the whole deployment is server-rendered. (2) A NEW NEAR-MISS SHAPE at Etienne Simonis: 'sans levurage, sans collage, sans chaptalisation ni acidification' — a prose statement of what was NOT added, which is the negative of an ingredient list and is not one. (3) A PRODUCER CAN HAVE NO WEBSITE AT ALL: Vignoble Luc Faller, confirmed by DNS, by the Vignerons Independants register and by the official Route des Vins d'Alsace directory — and vins-faller.fr is a different estate in the same village, the sharpest sister-name trap yet. (4) The Grand Sud ingredient list IS in circulation, complete, on Carrefour, Openfoodfacts and vinello.eu, and was refused: a record in this file outranks Systembolaget's, so an unsourced list here would override a correct absence. (5) Marc Morey closed six wines in five requests — its sitemap has seventeen URLs, none of them a wine. ALSO SETTLED A TLS TRAP THAT WILL RECUR ACROSS THE WHOLE PROJECT: 'unable to get local issuer certificate' on groupegcf.fr is ISRG ROOT YR, Let's Encrypt's 2025 root, absent from both the Pi's ca-certificates and certifi. Fixed honestly by adding Let's Encrypt's own cross-signed root-yr-by-x1.pem, which chains to the already-trusted ISRG Root X1; no verification was disabled. Any future 'TLS failure' with that message is our trust store, not the producer.

_runs.batch: 3g — six French producers with 2024+ undeclared wines, committed one producer at a time: Vignoble Hermouet, Domaine Bargemone, Alain Brumont, Château de Chausse, Domaine Fontanel, Domaine de la Bouvaude

The methodological finding is Domaine Bargemone: m.bargemone.com is NXDOMAIN and the estate is on VINCOD anyway, linked as https://vincod.com/{code}/get/print from its own WooCommerce page under the words 'Consulter la fiche technique' — so the two-DNS-lookup probe returns false negatives and the reliable test is one grep of one product page for the string 'vincod'. Domaine Fontanel is the strongest fiche-technique near-miss yet: current per-vintage PDFs matching cuvée, grape, alcohol and contenance exactly, with no ingredient list, no nutrition table and no energy value — on an estate whose robots.txt explicitly welcomes thirty-five AI agents and publishes an llms.txt. _runs.result: 8 attempted, 0 found, 8 not found, 0 rejected. FIVE OF THE SEVEN PRODUCERS HAD OUR EXACT BOTTLE ON THEIR OWN PAGE AND NONE OF THEM DECLARED ANYTHING ON IT. The finding is Domaine La Provenquiere: the estate hosts its OWN e-label pages at provenquiere.com/label-qr/, complete with ingredient lists and nutrition tables — and all four are 0,0 % products, whose lists are required by Regulation 1169/2011 outright, while not one of its actual wines has a QR page. A producer can publish exactly the declarations it is unambiguously obliged to publish and nothing more. Other shapes: Roumieux is the export-brand rule (the negociant label is absent from the family estate site); Saint Roch and Garon match Systembolaget on grapes and strength and state no vintage anywhere; Garon issues its fiches only through a contact form; Alain Jaume and Peraldi both carry our exact vintage on a first-party shop with only a sulphite line or nothing at all; Tracy is a vintage ahead on its shop and two vintages behind on its notice technique. New platform facts: the Soluxa shop skin ships an unused nutrition tab (tab2, ?nutrition); Wix keeps a product slug from first publication so store sitemaps are not a vintage census; and "kJ" matches "checkJQuery" in PrestaShop JS.

_runs.batch: 3 — Italy, first real Italian batch: SA.PI SPA (Sartori di Verona), Pico Maccario, Cantina Santa Maria La Palma, Ricasoli, Zorzettig, Vinosia, Cantina Valpolicella Negrar (Domini Veneti), Gruppo Italiano Vini (Bolla). Producers chosen for cluster size, one commit per producer.
_runs.result: 24 attempted, 0 found, 22 not found, 2 rejected — both rejections on vintage, against the FIRST ITALIAN DECLARATIONS THIS PROJECT HAS READ. Gruppo Italiano Vini publishes the complete mandated set inline on its own shop vinicum.com, inside the Apollo GraphQL payload (invisible to a stripped-text grep, visible to a raw one), with Annata and Formato rendered on the page — and both Bolla wines had rolled to the 2025 while the Swedish shelf holds the 2024. One other producer publishes real ingredient lists and not for our wines: Cantina Valpolicella Negrar self-hosts three /valori-nutrizionali-gransignoria-{wine} pages on cantinanegrar.com, all for a third brand, with the ingredient list as text and the nutrition table as a PNG. The dominant Italian failure is neither rendering nor the vintage but the UNDATED CUVEE PAGE: Sartori, Zorzettig, Santa Maria La Palma and Domini Veneti all keep one page per cuvee with no vintage anywhere, and their strongest label-adjacent statement is 'Allergeni: contiene solfiti / Origine: Prodotto in Italia'. Ricasoli is the exception that proves it — a genuine 808-URL per-vintage archive back to 2006, our exact 2024 on it with matching alcohol, and no ingredient list on any of it. Two new false positives named: a page called /qrcode01 that is a catalogue landing page (Pico Maccario), and hundreds of /de/etikette/ URLs that are WPML's German slug for the product post type (Ricasoli). One correction to an existing rule: a WordPress upload path is the date of FIRST upload, and Pico Maccario's 2019/06 scheda PDFs have Last-Modified 2025 — check the header before closing on the path.

_runs.batch: 3 — Italy, second batch: Cantina Terlan, Koefererhof Weingut, Hans Rottensteiner SRL, Weingut Pranzegg, Cantina LaVis, Ca' dei Frati, Tenute Piccini. Seven producers, fifteen wines, one commit per producer. Chosen to test two hypotheses: that the German-speaking Alto Adige producers would behave like the productive German pool, and that a group running its own e-commerce would publish, which is what the first Italian batch concluded from Gruppo Italiano Vini.
_runs.result: 15 attempted, 2 FOUND, 13 not found, 0 rejected. BOTH HYPOTHESES FAILED AND THE FIND CAME FROM NEITHER. The four Alto Adige / Trentino producers (Terlan, Koefererhof, Rottensteiner, Pranzegg) and the two co-op or group shops (LaVis, Piccini) published nothing; the two declarations are Ca' dei Frati's Pratto 2024 and Rosa dei Frati 2025, a Lombard family estate with no webshop at all, printing the complete mandated set inline on its ordinary /vini/{wine}/ marketing page — Annata, Bottiglia, Grado alcolico, PRODOTTO IN ITALIA - CONTIENE SOLFITI, an Ingredienti list and a Dichiarazione nutrizionale per 100 ml. Both matched on producer, cuvee, vintage, pack and alcohol exactly, so both were attached. The same estate runs a 96-URL /qr-code-promo/ tree — the most e-label-shaped URL tree seen in Italy — and it is pure marketing with no declaration on it; the disclosure is on the page the QR does not point at. Elsewhere: Terlan is the second Italian producer with a real per-vintage archive and declares nothing on it (and its 2024 page sits behind a query string its robots.txt disallows, so it was not fetched); Koefererhof is a three-page Squarespace brochure with no per-wine page at all and an empty sitemap; Rottensteiner and LaVis are one page per cuvee edited forward with a scheda tecnica that is analysis and prose; Pranzegg's only documented vintage is 2021 and its datasheet's strongest line is Total SO2 35 mg/l; Marchesi di Barolo and Tenute Piccini both run the same wineplatform.it shop, which keeps one product per vintage with the vintage in the slug and prints 'Contiene Solfiti - Prodotto in Italia' where the ingredient list would be. Two identity failures worth carrying: Pranzegg has no cuvee called 'Rosso per tutti', and Tenute Piccini's catalogue contains no organic Collezione Oro Chianti although it labels its other organic wines plainly. New false positives: 'e-label' matches Squarespace's 'toggle-label'/'event-date-label', the cookie-banner class 'cm-cookie-label', and JavaScript 'slideLabel' and 'whitelabel'; 'kJ' matches base64 PNG data ('ErkJggg==') and 'webpackJsonp' on Wix.
